_comment: Horizontal attack-path edges: a CONFIRMED/PARTIAL finding of class X -> ranked pivot candidates. Complements playbook.json (vertical: fingerprint->test). next_move.py ingests both. Candidates are SUGGESTIONS ONLY - nothing auto-executes; gate:'oob' marks blind/impactful edges needing an operator OOB callback before exploit. Score = 80 + 6*gain + round(8*likelihood) - {cheap:0,medium:3,expensive:6}[cost]. Class names must be in coverage-classes.json + CLASS_ALIASES vocab. Add edges, no code. Optional per-edge "verb" (discovered_on | enables | exploits | depends_on | links_vuln) renders as a [verb] tag in next_move output.
